description: A fetch client, OpenAPI operation and explicitly registered Express-style handler describe one HTTP route.

files.api/openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Authored route fixture
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /items/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: readItem
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Found

notes: These are route/reference dependencies as well as ordinary call dependencies. Parameter spellings :id, {id}, and the client interpolation identify the same route.
The fixture supplies route declarations without installing or running Express.
